desc:
Lucky Charms makes any day magically delicious

Toasted oat breakfast cereal with Lucky's magical marshmallows

Gluten free cereal provides at least 26 g of whole grain per serving (at least 48 g recommended daily)

Store this single-serve cup in your pantry as cereal for breakfast on the go, snacks for kids or birthday party favors

Contains: Twelve 1.7 oz single serve cereal cups of General Mills Lucky Charms Gluten Free Cereal with Marshmallows
features:
Features:

Gluten-Free

Made with oats that are carefully processed to be gluten-free, making it suitable for people with gluten sensitivities.

Whole Grain Oats

Contains whole grain as the first ingredient, offering a healthier cereal base.

Iconic Marshmallow Shapes

Includes colorful marshmallow charms in fun shapes like hearts, stars, horseshoes, clovers, blue moons, unicorns, and rainbows.

12 Essential Vitamins and Minerals

Fortified to support a balanced breakfast with added nutrients like calcium, iron, and vitamin D.

Low in Fat

A low-fat cereal choice for those looking to manage fat intake.

Kid-Approved Taste

Sweet and crunchy with a magical mix of flavor and fun, perfect for kids and nostalgic adults alike.

Benefits:

Safe for Gluten-Free Diets

Manufactured under strict processes to ensure it meets gluten-free standards.

Nutritionally Balanced Start to the Day

Combines whole grains, essential vitamins, and minerals to support daily nutritional goals.

Fun and Engaging Breakfast

The colorful marshmallows make breakfast exciting and encourage kids to enjoy a complete meal.

Versatile Usage

Can be eaten with milk, dry as a snack, or used in homemade treats like cereal bars and marshmallow squares.

Trusted Family Favorite

A classic cereal brand loved across generations for its taste and unique look.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Sugar, Whole Grain Corn, Corn Starch, Corn Syrup, Dextrose. Contains 2% or less of: Salt, Modified Corn Starch, Gelatin, Trisodium Phosphate, Red 40, Yellow 5 & 6, Blue 1, Natural and Artificial Flavor. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
